thesis: A10 Networks (NYSE: ATEN), application delivery and DDoS/security appliances. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-11-06) read in relevant sections. Q3 revenue 91.5M (+22.6%), 9M 246.7M (+17.4%); products +28% (hardware), services +3.5%; 9M NI 38.1M (+18%), tax 13%; 9M OCF 65.3M, capex 7.8M; inventory doubled to 36.4M (18.4M build). Cash 75.8M plus marketable securities 284.6M vs 225M 2.75% convertible due 2030 (conversion 23.46, in the money; fair value 299.8M) -> roughly net cash 60M on economic basis. Bought TrojAI (34.1M cash). Microsoft warrant for 800k shares tied to purchases (revenue reduction). Close 30.36 x 72.05M = 2.19B = 45.6x TTM NI 47.9M, FCF yield 3.4% (2.2% after SBC), 9.4x book. Top 10 end-customers 55% of revenue.
counterthesis: Priced at ~46x earnings for a ~10-15% growth hardware vendor; the Q3 jump is product-led and may be lumpy (service providers, ten customers = 55%). Inventory build and convertible in the money add dilution/cash claims; SBC 19.6M in 9M; Microsoft warrant reduces future revenue.
invalidation: Invalidated if product revenue growth reverses, large-customer orders slip, gross margin falls below ~77%, or inventory build turns into write-downs.
